name: HEALTHBANE - MedDefense Coverage (post-4x04)
description: HEALTHBANE campaign ATT&CK coverage after completion of project 4x04 (proactive threat hunt). Builds on the post-4x03 mapping by upgrading INFERRED lateral-movement and credential-access techniques to OBSERVED based on hunt-confirmed evidence at MedDefense. Used as the input baseline for 4x05 attack reconstruction.

techniques.comment: OBSERVED - 4x00 phishing dissection. Diane Marsh click 2026-04-14.
OBSERVED - 4x00 classified 3 of 8 emails as spearphishing link.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper analysis. HEALTHBANE_S2_invoice.docm requires user-enable-macros click.
OBSERVED - 4x03 exfiltrator sync_healthdata.ps1 + 4x04 hunt confirms PowerShell on SRV-HEALTH-DB.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper uses VBA macro (AutoOpen and Document_Open handlers).
OBSERVED - 4x03 RAT references HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\HealthSync.
OBSERVED - 4x01 + 4x03 + 4x04. HTTPS beaconing to sync.healthbane-c2.net:443 (185.220.101.45) every ~5 min.
OBSERVED - 4x03 exfiltrator constructs DNS TXT queries to data-sync.healthbane-c2.net. Capability confirmed in code; not yet exercised at volume against MedDefense.
OBSERVED - 4x03 RAT implements RC4-like stream cipher for C2 payload wrapping before TLS.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper base64+XOR-obfuscated VBA payload; exfiltrator uses encoded command invocations.
OBSERVED - 4x03 exfiltrator uses -EncodedCommand PowerShell invocation form.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper decodes embedded payload at runtime (chr()+XOR chain).
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper downloads svchost_update.exe from update.healthbane-c2.net/update/.
INFERRED - 4x03 exfiltrator has C2-upload code path. Not observed at MedDefense (Stage 3 interrupted at staging).
INFERRED - DNS exfiltration capability present in exfiltrator code. Not observed at volume at MedDefense.
INFERRED - exfiltrator targets database file patterns and SELECT query outputs. Database access confirmed in 4x04 hunt but specific data read not yet evidenced.
OBSERVED (attacker-side) - 4x00 WHOIS analysis confirmed newly registered lookalike domains.
OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt H4 confirmed LSASS access by debug_tool.exe on WS-RECV-03 (Sysmon EID 10, grantedAccess 0x1010, two events: 2026-05-05 and 2026-05-12).
OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt H1 confirmed PsExec64.exe lateral movement from WS-RECV-03 to SRV-HEALTH-DB, SRV-INS-DB, SRV-DC-01. UPGRADED from 4x02 INFERRED.
OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt H3 confirmed Enter-PSSession from WS-RECV-03 to SRV-HEALTH-DB and SRV-INS-DB. UPGRADED from 4x02 INFERRED.
OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt H2 confirmed WMI remote queries (wmiprvse.exe parent) from WS-RECV-03 against SRV-HEALTH-DB and SRV-INS-DB. UPGRADED from 4x02 INFERRED.
OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt confirmed valid-credential abuse beyond dmarsh: svc_healthsync used from non-authorized host WS-RECV-03 with NTLM (RULE 3 violation).
OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt: domain service account svc_healthsync abused for lateral movement. UPGRADED from 4x02 NOT COVERED.

OBSERVED - 4x04 hunt H5: NTLM authentication on a Kerberos-only service account is consistent with pass-the-hash. svc_healthsync was used cross-host with NTLM on every observed Stage 4 event. UPGRADED from 4x02 NOT COVERED.
OBSERVED - 4x03 sandbox + 4x04 hunt: PsExec service registration creates HKLM\...\Services\PSEXESVC entries on lateral targets.
NOT COVERED - Scheduled Task persistence. Not in 4x03 sandbox observations, not queried by 4x04 hunt. Open hypothesis for 4x05 IR forensics.
NOT COVERED - Local Data Staging. Advisory mentions Stage 3 staging at partner orgs but not observed at MedDefense. Open hypothesis for 4x05 disk forensics.
NOT COVERED - Archive via Utility (Compress-Archive). Capability present in exfiltrator code but artifacts not observed in 4x04. Open hypothesis for 4x05.
NOT COVERED - Clear Windows Event Logs. 4x04 hunt did not query for log gaps or wevtutil clear events. Open hypothesis for 4x05 IR.
